name: app-6ab582e45b5481919e74c6db3f72a18f
description: Nogbase real-estate workflows with six skills: Sales offer, Client shortlist, Project brief, Deal check, Nogbase actions and Nogbase API. It reads and changes Nogbase data within your permissions and asks before each change; the Nogbase API skill works through your signed-in nogbase CLI.
longDescription:
Nogbase helps real-estate brokers and property developers work with their Nogbase inventory, including off-plan projects. Search projects and units by area, developer, bedrooms, budget and currency, handover date, amenities, and payment-plan terms; compare projects for a client; read project details, brochures, and images; and prepare a sales offer or project brief with every payment-plan installment and your company letterhead. Developers can also review their own projects and recent inventory changes.

This package includes six skills that guide these workflows step by step: Sales offer (a branded offer for one unit at the quoted price, with every installment computed by Nogbase), Client shortlist (a buyer brief turned into filtered searches and a side-by-side comparison), Project brief (a project summary in English, Arabic, or both), Deal check (Nogbase's investment estimate for one unit from DLD sales, with sources, as-of dates and a disclaimer; an estimate, not advice), Nogbase actions (changes such as a unit price, a lead note or a hold, and any other Nogbase API operation, each shown to you and confirmed before it is made), and Nogbase API (for coding agents with a terminal: they read and change your Nogbase workspace through the nogbase CLI with your own sign-in, and ask before deleting or bulk changes).

The connector reads and changes Nogbase data within your own permissions in the connected workspace, and asks before each change; changes that need approval wait for it. The Nogbase API skill does the same from a terminal. Nogbase keeps a record of the connector's activity in your workspace, including the optional reason and request summary the assistant sends and how the request ended, for 180 days (see the privacy policy). A Nogbase broker or developer account is required.

positive.description: P1 Broker: shortlist search by area, bedrooms and budget
positive.prompt: Find projects in Dubai Marina with two-bedroom units under AED 3,000,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Dubai Marina, then searches with locationId, bedrooms 2, priceMax 3000000 and currencyCode AED. Lists matching projects with developer, starting price and handover, and marks project-level matches whose live availability is unconfirmed.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Peace Lagoons: developer, location, unit mix and starting price.
positive.expected_behavior: Peace Homes Development; Dubai Land Residence Complex, Dubai; the unit mix and the starting price as Nogbase returns them.

positive.description: P4 Broker: one-page sales offer at a quoted price
positive.prompt: Prepare a one-page sales offer for unit B827 in Peace Lagoons at AED 1,000,000 with my company letterhead and every payment-plan installment.
positive.expected_behavior: An offer in the chat under the Nogbase Properties letterhead, with each payment plan's installments recalculated by Nogbase from AED 1,000,000 (for example 20% = AED 200,000). Nothing is stored or sent in Nogbase.

positive.description: P5 Developer: own projects and recent inventory changes
positive.prompt: List my projects and tell me what changed in my inventory recently.
positive.expected_behavior: The Nogbase Development projects; the first update check returns a watermark and no history.

positive.description: P6 Broker: investment estimate for one unit (evaluate_unit)
positive.prompt: Is unit B827 in Peace Lagoons a good investment if it rents for AED 90,000 a year? Show what the buyer would make selling at handover.
positive.expected_behavior: Entry cost, payment schedule, market value from DLD sales, the sale at handover in each value scenario with verdicts stated as facts, break-even and yield from the given rent; every figure with its source and as-of date, plus Nogbase's disclaimer and attribution. An estimate, not advice; nothing is stored.

positive.description: P7 Developer: change one unit's price, confirmed first
positive.prompt: Change the price of unit CR-101 in Connector Review Residences to AED 1,050,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the unit and shows its current and new price, then asks. After the user's yes, calls PATCH /v1/units/{id} through call_api_write with the unit's version as ifMatch and reports the new price as Nogbase returns it, or gives the approvalId when the change waits for approval.

positive.description: P8 Broker: add a note to a lead, confirmed first
positive.prompt: Add a note to my lead Connector Review Lead: called today, wants a two-bedroom in Dubai Marina.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the lead, shows the note it will add and asks. After the user's yes, adds it through the lead-notes operation and reports the saved note.

positive.description: P9 Developer: place a hold on a unit, confirmed first
positive.prompt: Place a hold on unit CR-102 in Connector Review Residences for my client until Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the unit, describes the hold and asks. After the user's yes, places it through the hold operation and reports the hold as Nogbase returns it, or the approvalId when it waits for approval.

positive.description: P10 Broker: export a project's units as a download link
positive.prompt: Export the units of Peace Lagoons as a CSV file.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs POST /v1/inventory/projects/{projectId}/export/csv and gets status download. Gives the link and says it expires in about 15 minutes and that anyone holding it can open the file until then. The file itself is not in the chat.

positive.description: P11 Broker: a search that ends with report_outcome
positive.prompt: Show the available two-bedroom units in Peace Lagoons, cheapest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches Peace Lagoons with bedrooms 2 and sort price_asc (optionally passing user_intent and reason) and lists the available two-bedroom units, cheapest first (production: B827 at AED 1,526,000). Then, following the server instructions, calls report_outcome once with status accomplished and a one-sentence summary; it returns {"recorded": true}, makes no API call and changes no records, files or inventory.

positive.prompt: Create a new API key for my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Refused: no API key operation is offered (excluded operations answer as not found), so no key is created; the answer points to Settings, API keys, in the Nogbase app.

positive.description: N6 refusal: a write on a connection that did not allow changes
positive.prompt: Add a note to my lead Connector Review Lead: called today, wants a two-bedroom in Dubai Marina.
positive.expected_behavior: Refused: on a connection without the records:write permission the write fails with a message to reconnect Nogbase and allow changes; nothing changes, and the answer tells the user to reconnect and allow changes.

positive.description: N7 refusal: a Broker calling a Developer-only write
positive.prompt: Change the price of unit B827 in Peace Lagoons to AED 1,400,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Refused: asks first; after the user's yes, PATCH /v1/units/{id} answers 403 because the Broker workspace cannot call it; nothing changes, and the answer says so without claiming the price changed.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Dubai today?

negative.description: N4: general maths that needs no Nogbase data
negative.prompt: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment on an AED 2,000,000 loan at 4.5% interest over 25 years.

negative.description: N8: a writing task that needs no Nogbase data
negative.prompt: Draft a polite email declining a meeting invitation for next Tuesday.

publication.release_notes: Update 1.7.0 (includes the unpublished 1.6.0): the connector can now change Nogbase data within the user's permissions, asking before each change. Adds the create_record and update_record tools and four API tools (search_api_operations, describe_api_operation, call_api_read, call_api_write) for the rest of Nogbase's stable v1 API, the records:write permission, and the Nogbase actions skill (six skills in all). Changes that need approval wait for it; exports come back as short-lived download links. Every tool now accepts two optional inputs, reason (at most 128 characters) and user_intent (at most 256 characters), which the tools ignore and Nogbase records in the workspace's AI activity; the new report_outcome tool records how the user's request ended (status, a one-sentence summary, up to five unmet needs) and changes no records. AI activity records are kept for 180 days and are described in sections 15 and 16 of https://nogbase.ae/privacy. Each workspace lists only the tools it can call (23 for a developer, 24 for a broker; 25 in all).
